title: hydrocotyle chevalieri
intro: Hydrocotyle chevalieri, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a medicinal plant belonging to the Hydrocotyle genus. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hydrocotyle chevalieri are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-anxiety effects, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
